# kevy-flutter

Publishing artifact for [`flutter_kevy`](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_kevy)
— kevy embedded in a Flutter app over `dart:ffi`.

This repository is **generated** from `bindings/flutter` in
[goliajp/kevy](https://github.com/goliajp/kevy) and exists so the
published package can carry the native engine (11 MB per release)
without that payload living in the engine repository forever.

Issues and pull requests belong on
[goliajp/kevy](https://github.com/goliajp/kevy); anything committed
here is overwritten by the next release.

```
flutter pub add flutter_kevy
```

Documentation: https://kevy.golia.jp
